title: This Gun Fires a 40-Pound Slug at Mach 7 With No Explosives

scenes.text: This gun fires a slug at seven times sound speed.
It uses no gunpowder and no explosives.
Just electricity. A huge current surges through two metal rails and pushes the slug along.
In one record test, the US Navy used thirty-three megajoules of energy.
The slug weighs forty pounds and can fly up to a hundred miles. A standard five-inch naval gun reaches about thirteen.

description:
The US Navy's railgun fires a forty-pound slug at about seven times the speed of sound, with no explosives.
A huge electric current drives the slug down two metal rails, and a record test used 33 megajoules of energy.
Would you want to be near one?
first_comment: One megajoule can throw a one-ton car at a hundred miles an hour. This one used thirty-three. Would you want to see it fire?
